title: RAW zero-new-value complete units under the fixed91 music meanings: capacity gate with an explicit missing generalized construction
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Before any new target-body access or census, offer exact literal coverage of every complete currently admitted GDT928 ZL/IT paragraph outside physical development leaves76/83 by the unchanged91 music denotations. No new values, aliases, length threshold or favorable survivor selection. Zero survivors parks this closed-inventory extension. Any survivors must all be retained; the old locus/position-bound recognizers are not a portable grammar, so a separate explicit whole-construction contract would be required before semantic execution. This is a method capacity gate, not a new meaning result.

design.mechanism: Exact fixed whole-form vocabulary coverage of complete admitted units, followed only after a separate decision by any explicitly frozen reusable full-construction contract. The first stage supplies no new denotations or semantic execution.
design.unit: Every native complete GDT928 ZL3b or IT2a paragraph on currently admitted selectors; other physical leaves than76/83 define the prospective extension partition. Whole development leaves remain excluded even when the other side or a different paragraph was not used to fit the family.
design.contrast: No complete literal paragraph covered versus one or more completely covered paragraphs. Grammar absence, no parse, missing binding and semantic contradiction remain separate later outcomes; none can be inferred from coverage.
design.prediction: A portable closed91 whole-word reading requires every literal form of any new fully read paragraph to belong to those91 unchanged entries. All prospective survivors are retained before any new semantic consequence or grammar is declared.
design.scope: Only a prospective exact lexical-capacity gate on all complete admitted units. No target census or new bodies opened by this proposal; no labels promoted to running paragraphs; no semantic consequence claimed.

decision_note.unknown: Whether any complete additional literal paragraph is covered by the present91 entries. The bounded predecessor audit found no prior all-complete-unit zero-new-value census for this exact91 inventory. This is a bounded coverage statement, not proof of absence from all history.

why_outcomes_change_decision.zero_extension_survivors: Park extension under the unchanged91 whole-word inventory. Do not select a nearly covered paragraph, relax literal spelling, add words or build a generalized constructor in this task. Old conditional readings remain intact.
why_outcomes_change_decision.one_or_more_survivors: Retain every survivor with full literal rows, uncertainty and source ownership. Root may separately select authorship of a reusable full construction contract. Coverage alone does not justify a performance simulation, a favorable subset or a meaning claim.
why_outcomes_change_decision.source_scope_not_proven: Do not census. Preserve an access/ownership gap distinct from lexical or semantic failure.

decision_note.smallest_adequate_test_if_selected: One fixed-inventory membership pass with independent count/partition reconstruction over all eligible complete units, retaining all forms and exact positions. No decoder, performance simulator, image work or threshold sweep.
decision_note.no_automatic_continuation: A positive capacity result does not authorize constructor development. Root must select and preregister a concrete complete grammar with participant/reference behavior before reading any result as semantic transfer.

construction_gap.what_is_not_licensed: Erasing locus checks, relabelling positions, concatenating the31 old productions in a new order, silently adding context/role lists, treating all appearances as generic assertions, or reusing an old trace without compiling every new group would each add assumptions. An exact old-clause match by itself cannot create an unmentioned performance or participant list.

strongest_countercases_and_limits: A91-entry inventory fitted on three paragraphs may cover no further whole paragraph. A zero count would park this inventory extension, not refute music or all possible languages.
A covered paragraph can still have no complete parse under any explicitly justified old construction; the old executors are positional and cannot be advertised as portable.
The old same-role, participant and performance identities remain assumptions. No new paragraph is automatically about the same physical performers or event.
Old IT whole-form and clause conflicts and uncertain ZL seams survive. Literal membership must not inherit projected spellings by convenience.
The positive F11 reading already contradicts the prior prohibition for N3/N4; N2 has an empty range. Reproducing this is not a new discriminating consequence.
No target is independent holdout data. A lexical census cannot confirm a word, select a source, establish pictured performers or justify opening reserves.
